# dsh.pub

> Source-backed directory and development guide for the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem.

## Agent guide

- [Develop a DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://dsh.pub/develop-plugin.md): Agent-first contract for
  building Host plugins, Web UI clients, independently installable bundle layers, verification, and
  dsh.pub catalog admission. Read the target repository's own Agent instructions first.

## Catalog

- [English plugin catalog](https://dsh.pub/en/plugins/): Built-in and source-reviewed community
  capabilities.
- [中文插件目录](https://dsh.pub/zh/plugins/): 内置插件与经过源码契约核对的社区插件。

## Provenance

- [DeepSeek Harness source](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- [dsh.pub source](https://github.com/OneeMe/dsh-pub)
